Toxel

Electric Poison

Galar · Generation 8 · Baby Pokémon

Toxel is an Electric/Poison-type Baby Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 11 kg. It evolves into Toxtricity. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (54), with a base stat total of 242.
